name: How long does a typical sliding door flashing repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sliding door flashing repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sliding door flashing repair depends on the complexity and extent of the damage. A minor repair, such as resealing a small section, might take a few hours. More extensive repairs involving significant water damage, structural remediation, or siding replacement could take one to two full days, or even longer for multiple door repairs. A contractor can provide a time estimate after assessing the specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor issues to one or two days or more for extensive damage requiring structural remediation.
